title: A Teammate Missed the Deadline

prompt.scenario: You and your classmate Maya are collaborating on a joint presentation for your urban sociology seminar. Maya has missed two consecutive internal group deadlines to submit her case study slides, delaying the group rehearsal. Write an email to Maya.
requirements: Acknowledge the slides that the rest of the group has already completed.
Explain how the missing case study slides are holding up the final slide deck and rehearsal.
Propose a manageable deadline of tomorrow evening and offer to help format her section.

modelEssay:
Hi Maya,

I hope your week is going well. I am writing to check in on our presentation slides for Sociology 201.

Our team has already completed the introduction, background research, and statistical analysis charts, and we assembled them into the shared presentation deck yesterday. However, we are still waiting on your section regarding local housing case studies. Because our group is scheduled to rehearse together on Friday afternoon and verify our individual speaking times, we need your content to finalize the transitions. Could you please upload your three case study slides by tomorrow at 6:00 PM? If you have your rough notes ready, I would be very happy to jump on a quick call to help format them. Let me know if that works for you.

Best,
Alex

If your energy permits, would you like to meet in the library cafe for thirty minutes before class tomorrow to go over the practice questions together? Let me know, and take good care of yourself.

Best,
Alex

title: Reporting a Bicycle Theft Concern

prompt.scenario: You commute to campus by bicycle and park at the east entrance bike racks of Juniper Hall. Write an email to the campus public safety coordinator, Ms. Upton.
requirements: Report the severed bicycle locks and recent bike thefts at the Juniper Hall east racks.

Dear Ms. Upton,

I am writing to report an escalating property theft issue and security concern outside Juniper Residence Hall.

Alex Morgan

title: Requesting a Kitchen Cleaning Plan

prompt.scenario: You live on the fourth floor of Oak Hall. The communal kitchen has repeatedly been left with unwashed frying pans, food splatters across the stovetop, and uncovered leftovers on countertops over the weekend. Write an email to your floor Resident Advisor, Jordan.

modelEssay:
Hi Jordan,

I am writing to raise a sanitation concern regarding our fourth-floor communal kitchen in Oak Hall and to suggest a collaborative solution.

Throughout the past two weekends, several residents have repeatedly left greasy frying pans in the sinks, dried sauce splatters across the stovetops, and uncovered food containers on the countertops overnight. The resulting odor has become noticeable down the hall, and yesterday morning several residents observed ants near the food preparation area. In addition, the cluttered counters make it difficult for other students to prepare their daily meals comfortably. Could we implement a rotating nightly cleaning checklist where residents sign off on wiping down surfaces? Furthermore, could you dedicate ten minutes at our upcoming Sunday floor meeting to establish clear community expectations regarding kitchen cleanliness? I would be glad to help draft the checklist. Thank you for your leadership.

Best,
Alex
